articles.title: Ochre Arctic
articles.summary: Fine blue and ochre speckle, like sand and sea spray mixed, with a soft arctic glow shifting underneath. A busy cyan and amber mosaic; from distance the lattice blends into mottled turquoise and gold with a slight rosette texture.
articles.what: Ochre drift with arctic light moving under it. Up close: A fine quasi-crystal lattice of interlocking rings and rosettes about 15-25 px wide, drawn in ochre-brown lines with sky-blue cells between them, like Islamic tile or moire interference. Blue dominates in some areas, ochre in others, over zones about 150 px wide. Sharp and regular, no sandy speckle. From a distance: A busy cyan and amber mosaic; from distance the lattice blends into mottled turquoise and gold with a slight rosette texture. Measured spec (average): metal 119, roughness 84, coat 103. Shine: satin. Metal: medium. It brings its own colours.
